tools.name: ahrefs_keyword_overview
tools.description: Search volume, keyword difficulty (KD), CPC, and traffic potential for one or more keywords. The 'is there demand?' primitive. Cost = 1 row per keyword.

keywords.description: Keywords to look up (e.g. ['data analytics certificate', 'business analytics']). One keyword per array element (no commas); max 100 per call; cost = 1 row per keyword.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb'). Defaults to AHREFS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.

tools.name: ahrefs_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Discover keyword ideas from a seed term (matching / related / suggestions). Use to expand a seed into the surrounding language landscape. Cost = limit rows.

seed.description: Seed keyword or phrase (e.g. 'data analytics certificate').

mode.description: Discovery mode: 'matching' (terms containing the seed), 'related' (semantically related), or 'suggestions' (autocomplete-style).

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb'). Defaults to AHREFS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.

limit.description: Number of keyword ideas to return (1-1000). Larger values cost more Ahrefs rows.

tools.name: ahrefs_keyword_history
tools.description: Monthly search-volume history for a keyword. The 'growing / flat / dying?' primitive for spotting which pockets of demand are rising. Cost = months rows.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb'). Defaults to AHREFS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.

tools.name: ahrefs_serp_overview
tools.description: Top organic results for a keyword plus each result's domain metrics (rating, traffic). Answers 'who already owns this search?' for competitive saturation. Cost = limit rows.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb'). Defaults to AHREFS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.

limit.description: Number of SERP positions to return (1-100). Larger values cost more Ahrefs rows.

tools.name: ahrefs_domain_organic_keywords
tools.description: Keywords a competitor domain ranks for in organic search. Surfaces adjacent-program signals (what is Coursera/edX ranking for that you aren't?). Optional keyword_filter scopes the scan. Cost = limit rows.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb'). Defaults to AHREFS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.

limit.description: Number of ranking keywords to return (1-1000). Larger values cost more Ahrefs rows.

keyword_filter.description: Optional substring filter, only return keywords containing this string (e.g. 'analytics').

tools.name: ahrefs_domain_top_pages
tools.description: Top traffic-driving pages on a competitor domain (typically program landing pages, catalog pages, explainers). Cost = limit rows.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'us', 'gb'). Defaults to AHREFS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY.

limit.description: Number of top pages to return (1-500). Larger values cost more Ahrefs rows.

tools.name: ahrefs_subscription_usage
tools.description: Ahrefs' own subscription limits and row usage (the authoritative spend source). Free / unmetered. Call before a multi-tool report run to see how many rows remain on the plan.
